pages.title: Corundum
pages.text: Aluminium oxide, as hard as anything but diamond. Coloured by a trace of iron and titanium it is sapphire; by chromium, ruby. Clear and hard, it makes the best lenses and bearings.
$(thing)Used in$(): Corundum Crystal Mass, MHD Channel Casing, Moissanite Drill, Refractory Boots, Refractory Chestplate, Refractory Firebox, Refractory Helmet, Refractory Leggings and more.
